info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Competitor Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Competitor Reviews Submission API enables businesses to contribute insights about competitor products through reviews. This endpoint is particularly valuable for market analysts and product managers who seek to gather competitive intelligence. Users can submit detailed reviews associated with specific competitors as part of comprehensive business analysis efforts. Integrating this data can enhance decision-making and strategic planning within an organization.

post.summary: Submit a review for a competitor analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review related to a specific competitor analysis resource. It facilitates feedback collection to improve the analysis process and offerings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit reviews for a specific competitor analysis identified by RES-100045. The provided JSON payload should include all necessary information related to the review, such as rating, comments, and any additional metadata as defined in the associated schema.
